arguments.sql:
SELECT action,
       COUNT(*) AS events,
       COUNT(DISTINCT path) AS distinct_paths,
       SUM(path IS NULL OR path = '') AS missing_paths,
       SUM(session IS NULL OR session = '') AS missing_sessions,
       SUM(datetime(stamp) IS NULL) AS invalid_timestamps,
       MIN(stamp) AS first_timestamp,
       MAX(stamp) AS last_timestamp,
       MIN(path) AS first_path,
       MAX(path) AS last_path
FROM activity_log
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY action

arguments.sql:
WITH session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT log.path,
       COUNT(*) AS visits,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN log.stamp = bounds.first_stamp OR log.stamp = bounds.last_stamp THEN log.session END) AS endpoint_sessions
FROM activity_log AS log
JOIN session_bounds AS bounds ON bounds.session = log.session
GROUP BY log.path
ORDER BY log.path

arguments.sql:
WITH page_views AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, path
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
),
session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM page_views
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT
    views.path,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN views.stamp IN (bounds.first_stamp, bounds.last_stamp)
        THEN views.session
    END) AS session_count
FROM page_views AS views
JOIN session_bounds AS bounds ON bounds.session = views.session
WHERE views.path <> ''
GROUP BY views.path
ORDER BY views.path
LIMIT -1
